BRICS Chief Justices' Forum Convenes in New Delhi

The BRICS Chief Justices' Forum commenced in New Delhi, with Chief Justice Surya Kant engaging with judicial leaders from BRICS nations. During the forum, Chief Justice Surya Kant emphasized the importance of strengthening bilateral relations among BRICS countries. The event brought together judicial heads from Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa.
